test_title: PYST 32: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 25 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

A + B means ‘A is the son of B’,

A − B means ‘A is the wife of B’,

A × B means ‘A is the brother of B’ and

A ÷ B means ‘A is the mother of B’.

Based on the above, how is T related to P if ‘P − M + R ÷ T × S’?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 -
 +
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Wife
 Son
 Brother
 Mother
 
 

 

Given: P − M + R ÷ T × S

It means: P is the wife of M, M is the son of R, R is the mother of T and T is the brother of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/22fe0da2f3bfc931538e266cc68c6117cf666b7f64588e932f0eb4eeaf8770b9.png] 

So, T is the '**Husband’s brother**' of P.

Hence, the correct answer is "Husband’s brother".
